text-start cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">插件和技能（Skills）有什么区别？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 arrow-icon--open"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pe-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 type-body whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) answer-text--open">技能为 Kimi 提供完成任务所需的知识、步骤和方法。插件是可安装的能力扩展包，可以包含技能，也可以提供连接外部软件、数据源或服务的工具。例如，一个 Notion 插件可以同时包含 Notion 连接能力和指导 Kimi 如何使用它的技能。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-automatic" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pe-4 ps-0 w-full text-start cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">Kimi 会自动使用插件吗？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-automatic" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pe-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 type-body whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">会。你可以直接描述任务，Kimi 会根据任务自动选择合适的插件；你也可以输入「/」或点击输入框的「+」，主动指定一个或多个插件。调用时，回复中会显示正在使用的插件。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-account" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pe-4 ps-0 w-full text-start cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">使用插件需要连接第三方账号吗？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-account" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pe-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 type-body whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">取决于插件。部分插件需要登录第三方服务并完成授权；部分插件已预装，无需手动安装。安装时请按插件详情页的提示操作。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-access" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pe-4 ps-0 w-full text-start cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">连接后，Kimi 能访问我账号里的哪些内容？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-access" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pe-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 type-body whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">Kimi 会在你授权的范围内访问完成任务所需的相关内容。不同插件可读取的数据和可执行的操作不同，具体以插件的授权说明为准。第三方插件的数据处理还受服务提供方的条款和隐私政策约束。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-availability" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pe-4 ps-0 w-full text-start cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">插件在哪些端和场景可用？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 answer-text flex-1 type-body whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">在 Kimi 中，切换至 K3 或 K3 集群，以及使用深度研究、构建应用、PPT 等场景时，可以使用插件；Kimi Work 桌面端也支持插件。网页端和移动端可通过输入框的「+」或「/」进入插件入口。实际可用的插件会因地区、使用端和账号类型而异。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-noCode" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex
